title: CMIP7 Extension
description: STAC CMIP7 Extension for STAC Items and STAC Collection Summaries.

oneOf.$comment: This is the schema for STAC Items.
This is the schema for STAC Collections, or more specifically only Collection Summaries in this case. By default, only checks the existence of the properties, but not the schema of the summaries.

enum: A consortium of Korean research institutions contributing to CMIP7 through Earth system modeling. Led by the Korea Institute of Ocean Science and Technology (KIOST) in collaboration with Hanyang University (HYU).
Alfred Wegener Institute for Polar and Marine Research
CNRM (Centre National de Recherches Meteorologiques, Toulouse 31057, France), CERFACS (Centre Europeen de Recherche et de Formation Avancee en Calcul Scientifique, Toulouse 31057, France)

MRI (Meteorological Research Institute) conducts research for the improvement of information issued by JMA (Japan Meteorological Agency) on weather, earthquakes, volcanic activity, climatic conditions and other phenomena.

NorESM Climate modeling Consortium (NCC) consists of Norwegian institutions MET-Norway, NORCE, NERSC, UiB, UiO, NILU and CICERO with a joint ambition to develop and maintain the Norwegian Earth System Model (NorESM) as a cutting-edge climate model and contribute to future Coupled Model Intercomparison Projects, climate assessment reports and scenario computations for climate services.
Sun Yat-sen University, a public university in Guangzhou, China.

The ACCESS Consortium brings together Australian institutions contributing to the Australian Community Climate and Earth System Simulator (ACCESS) and its submissions to the Coupled Model Intercomparison Project (CMIP). Participating organisations contribute to different ACCESS models and scientific activities, supported through a combination of institutional investment and Australian Government research infrastructure and research programs, together with international collaborations.

The German Aerospace Center DLR is the Federal Republic of Germany's research centre for aviation, space, energy, transport, and security. The DLR Institute of Atmospheric Physics conducts research into the physics and chemistry of the global atmosphere, from the ground up to the upper edge of the middle atmosphere at an altitude of approximately 120 km.

The National Institute for Space Research (INPE) is Brazil's leading agency for space science and earth observation, operating across several key fields: space science and atmospheric research, satellite development and aerospace engineering, remote sensing and Earth observation, numerical weather forecasting, and Earth system science, which includes extensive deforestation monitoring in the Amazon.
The National Institute of Meteorological Sciences (NIMS) is the research institute of the Korea Meteorological Administration (KMA).
The National Science Foundation National Center for Atmospheric Research (NSF NCAR) manages the development and maintenance of the Community Earth System Model (CESM).
The Research Center for Environmental Changes, Academia Sinica (AS-RCEC) is responsible for the development and maintenance of the Taiwan Earth System Model (TaiESM) in Taiwan.
UK National Centre for Atmospheric Science

UKNCSP is a strategic partnership between the Met Office and six NERC-funded research centres in the UK. This partnership consists of the British Antarctic Survey (BAS), British Geological Survey (BGS), Met Office, National Centre for Atmospheric Science (NCAS), National Centre for Earth Observation (NCEO), National Oceanography Centre (NOC) and UK Centre for Ecology & Hydrology (UKCEH), with a mission to unite and harness UK climate science capability, advance international partnerships, and drive solutions for a resilient, net-zero world.
US National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration's Geophysical Fluid Dynamics Laboratory.
